newsitem.title: USA: Saudi, U.S. energy officials hold meeting.
newsitem.headline: Saudi, U.S. energy officials hold meeting.

text.p: Saudi Oil Minister Ali Naimi and Deputy Minister Prince Abdul Aziz Bin Salman and five Saudi advisers were holding a lunch meeting Tuesday with top U.S. energy officials.
Acting U.S. Energy Secretary Charles Curtis hosted the lunch, which was not attended by Energy Secretary nominee Federico Pena, an Energy Department spokeswoman said.
The officials were expected to discuss oil policies, potential leasing of space in the U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve to the Saudis, and global warming policies, department officials have said.
Saudi and U.S. officials were expected to make remarks after the meeting.
